note: The interactive level mapping step and the name of migration M2. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.common` wrapper and merge the children into the central `common` namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw. Interpolation tokens are shown literally in the values. The migration's diagnostics (the reason a legacy row could not be mapped, the level and year it wrote) stay English on purpose: a data migration has no access to the translation layer, and the operator sees them as data diagnostics.

migration.m2Name: Migrate the classes and streams into levels and class groups

levelMapping.title: Match the old classes to levels
levelMapping.intro: Every old class becomes a level, and every old stream becomes a class group in an academic year. Check each suggestion before the database is changed.
levelMapping.rule: The suggestion reads the class name (Form 1, Grade 7, Year 8) and takes the academic year that covers today. Correct anything that is wrong; the migration uses your decisions, not the suggestion.
levelMapping.loadFailed: The old classes could not be read: {{error}}
levelMapping.noYears: No academic year is available. Run the calendar migration first, then come back to this step.
levelMapping.orphanTitle: These streams point at a class the old database does not hold and will not be migrated:
levelMapping.unconfirmed: This mapping is a suggestion that has not been confirmed yet. Confirm it to save the decisions the migration uses.
levelMapping.empty: The old database holds no class to match.
levelMapping.noStreams: This class has no streams: it becomes one class group with the class name.
levelMapping.streamsCaption: The streams and the learners in them
levelMapping.yearCorrected: The year for {{stream}} was changed by you.
levelMapping.problemLevel: The level for {{className}} needs a name and a code.
levelMapping.problemOrdinal: The level order for {{className}} must be a whole number from 0.
levelMapping.saved: The mapping is saved. The migration will use these decisions.
levelMapping.saveFailed: The mapping could not be saved: {{error}}
